title: Republic of Korea AI Action Plan (AI Basic Plan 2026–2028)
summary: Government-wide AI plan adopted by the presidential National AI Strategy Committee at its second plenary meeting on 25 February 2026, after a report to the Cabinet on 10 February 2026. It is the statutory AI Basic Plan required by Article 6 of the AI Basic Act and covers 2026–2028. A draft with 98 tasks was released in December 2025. The final plan sets 99 implementation tasks and 326 policy recommendations under three pillars (an AI innovation ecosystem, nationwide AI-based transformation, contribution to a global AI basic society) and 12 strategic areas, aimed at making Korea one of the top three AI powers.
